name: Felix
source:
He/Him

Works as a bartender at Jeffersonville Pub. He is cool, charismatic and appears happy on the surface, but has a nasty addiction to Numb-X. Deep down he is suffering with addiction and depression but you would never know it at a glance. He has a hard time trusting people and opening up about these feelings, and instead chooses to ignore them and smile though the pain.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3730050/Princess_of_Worlds_End/]Steam[/url]]
